general_information.Description: This course covers the fundamentals of working Ui/Ux (Interaction Design). It’s only a starting point, though. As with any artistic pursuit, (Interaction Design) is a lifelong process of learning.With what you learn in this course forming a solid foundation, you can continue exploring all the complex.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FLM https://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: A4, Photoshop, Illsutrator, Adobe XD, Figma, Sketch …

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Students understand basic concepts, techniques, and knowledge of interaction design.
Analysis the interactive design process of Designing, Modeling, Evaluation, Setting, Finishing.
Ability to practice proficiently in all kinds of strokes and shapes in each specific sketch object with details.
Students applications prototype, describe prototyping and different types of prototyping activities, the range of tool support available for interaction design.
Create drawings with complete layouts that convey the content of the story being told and make good use of knowledge and skills learned of sketch.
Students have a proficient in presentation and teamworks.

assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Understand the framework developing Ideas and user testing Develop storyboards to demonstrate ideas, develop user flows and wireframes, conduct usability testing, analyze testing results to refine the wireframes
assessments.Grading Guide: Students develop ideas into wireframes and iterate with user feedbacks by conducting user testings
assessments.Note: Select the members, 2-3 members / group and define the group topic Student must deliver assignment in time. Submission Required: - Report in 16:9 format (PDF) - Testing Results (.xls or pdf format) - Wireframes (.fig)

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Understand different between user testing and peer-to-peer evaluation. Understand 10 Nielsen Heuristic Evaluations Conduct peer-to-peer evaluation, Finaliza wireframes and prototypes, Present final works
assessments.Grading Guide: Students finalize wireframes after 1 one more user testing round and a peer-to-peer evaluations.
assessments.Note: Select the members, 2-3 members / group and define the group topic Student must deliver assignment in time. Submission required: - Final Report in 16:9 format (PDF) - Testing Results (.xls or pdf format) - Wireframes (.fig)

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Understand the process of conducting research, definition of different frameworks that being used in User research Conduct literature Review, planning research, formulate survey questionnaires, analyze data from research, identify insights, ideate solutions from problem statements
assessments.Grading Guide: Students identify painpoints of users and ideate solutions to solve them by conducting ldesk research and field research on the assigned topic about definition of the experience & user behaviors.
assessments.Note: Select the members, 2-3 members / group and define the group topic Student must deliver assignment in time. Submission required: - Research Report in A4 format (PDF)
